capabilities.name: storage
capabilities.reason: Stores each received share as a File, with the fetched copy, in the folder you choose.

sharesFolder.description: Subject of the folder received shares are stored in. Receiving is off until it is set.

allowedPeers.description: Object mapping the domains of OCM servers you accept shares from (e.g. cloud.example.org) to true. Every other server gets 403.

recipients.description: Object mapping the user part of the OCM addresses on this server that may receive shares (bob for bob@<this host>) to their display name.

providerName.description: Name shown to other OCM servers in discovery. Defaults to Atomic Server.

keys.name: ocm-key
keys.reason: Signs the OCM notifications this drive sends, and is published at /ocm/jwks for other servers to verify them.

http.reason: Lets servers that speak Open Cloud Mesh 1.5 with RFC 9421 signatures share files with people on this drive. Anyone can call these endpoints; only servers you allow, with a valid signature, can store anything.
